user.title: Sigenergy TC
user.description: Choose the connections you want to use. You can add or disable each connection later.

local.title: Local plant
local.description: Enter the local Modbus address. Use a dedicated connection, or explicitly select an additional read-only connection alongside an existing client. Additional read-only connections poll no faster than once per minute.

data.sole_modbus_client: I have stopped competing Modbus clients for this plant
data.shared_read_only: Additional read-only connection alongside an existing client
data.allow_shared_writes: Allow TC writes while other Modbus clients monitor

data_description.inverter_unit_id: Use the actual inverter unit ID, not the plant address 247. Required for serial-bound local controls.
data_description.allow_shared_writes: TC must be the only writer. Other clients may monitor; disable their dispatch automations. Shared read-only mode must be off to write.

features.title: Choose optional features
features.description: Select installed forecasts covering the same complete panel array. Choose both providers and enable averaging here, or leave the selection empty to continue without a forecast.

data.optimizer_monitoring: Plan to use panel optimizer monitoring
data.primary_source: Main forecast when averaging is off

wizard_forecast.title: Choose {provider_name} data
wizard_forecast.description: Choose the provider configuration or aggregate detailed forecast sensors covering today and tomorrow.

wizard_cloud.title: Optional cloud account
wizard_cloud.description: Sign in with your mySigen account. Your plant is detected automatically. Credentials stay in Home Assistant storage. This optional app interface is unofficial; plant control is enabled separately.

data.unofficial_opt_in: I accept optional use of the unofficial app interface

dashboard.title: Choose your dashboard
dashboard.description: Choose defaults for the complete dashboard or individual cards. After setup, use Configure → Add to dashboard to place it on an existing page or supported custom menu without editing YAML.

review.title: Review your setup

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Choose Local Modbus, mySigen Cloud, or both. Cloud works without Modbus. Modbus must first be enabled on the system by your installer.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect mySigen Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for your existing account. Your selected plant, entities and other settings are preserved.

wizard_control.title: Owner control and limits
wizard_control.description: Power follows verified plant/device limits automatically. Turn automatic power off only to set your own lower caps. Setup does not send plant commands. Export approval does not change the plant export limit.

data.export_permitted: My site is approved for grid export

data_description.enable_local_control: Uses HA-managed timing and native SOC bounds. Configure the primary inverter unit and local write ownership first. HA must remain running to restore commands on time.
data_description.use_plant_power_limits: Uses fresh Modbus/device ratings or finite native app limits. Missing or unlimited metadata is not replaced with a guessed power value.

wizard_power_limits.title: Custom power caps
wizard_power_limits.description: Optional lower caps for TC commands. Verified plant and device limits still apply. These preferences do not change plant settings during setup.

error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL path.
error.competing_client: Confirm a dedicated connection or choose an additional read-only connection.
error.forecast_provider_missing: Install and configure this provider first, or choose no forecast.
error.invalid_forecast_source: Choose up to two loaded forecast sources and a main source from your selection.
error.cloud_opt_in_required: Explicit opt-in is required for the unofficial app interface.
error.cloud_fields_required: Enter your mySigen username and password, or disable cloud reads.
error.invalid_auth: Sigenergy rejected the cloud sign-in. Verify the mySigen account and selected region.
error.cannot_connect: Sigenergy Cloud is unavailable or rate-limiting requests. Try again later.
error.no_cloud_plant: The account plant could not be discovered. Sign-in may have succeeded; this can be an app-interface or account-access issue.
error.cloud_login_failed: The integration could not complete cloud login. This is not confirmation of incorrect credentials. Check the integration log for the safe error category.
error.wrong_account: This account returned a different plant. Your existing plant has not been changed.
error.invalid_safety_limits: Reserve must be below the ceiling; power values must be finite and positive.
error.invalid_inverter_unit: Enter a whole inverter unit ID from 1 to 246.

abort.already_configured: This plant or demo is already configured.
abort.cloud_not_configured: This entry no longer has a configured cloud account.

safety.title: Safety limits
safety.description: Power follows verified plant/device limits automatically. Turn automatic power off only to set your own lower caps. Setup does not send plant commands. Export approval does not change the plant export limit.

data.export_permitted: My site is approved for grid export

data_description.use_plant_power_limits: Uses fresh Modbus/device ratings or finite native app limits. Missing or unlimited metadata is not replaced with a guessed power value.

forecast.title: Choose an installed forecast provider
forecast.description: Select installed forecasts covering the same complete panel array. Choose both providers and enable averaging here, or leave the selection empty to continue without a forecast.

data.primary_source: Main forecast when averaging is off

forecast_source.title: Choose {provider_name} data
forecast_source.description: Select the configured Forecast.Solar entry, or total daily forecast sensors covering today and tomorrow. Detailed forecast attributes must be available; incomplete data remains unknown.

cloud.title: mySigen Cloud account
cloud.description: Sign in with your mySigen account. Your plant is detected automatically. Credentials stay in Home Assistant storage. This optional app interface is unofficial; plant control is enabled separately.

data.unofficial_opt_in: I accept using the unofficial app interface for optional reads

dashboard.title: Choose your dashboard
dashboard.description: One complete card or separate cards, with layouts that adapt to phone, tablet and computer. Save these defaults now; add the dashboard resource and card afterwards using the card guide. This wizard does not change existing dashboards.

placement.title: Add Sigenergy TC to a dashboard
placement.description: Choose an existing editable dashboard. Only the destination selected in the next step will change. A rollback copy is saved before placement.

placement_target.title: Choose the destination
placement_target.description: Select an existing page or custom menu. Existing native page cards are preserved. For custom menus, confirm that the shell supports embedded Home Assistant cards; the updated Tab A7 shell does. Replacing an existing menu card requires explicit confirmation.

data.replace_existing: Replace the existing card in this menu
data.shell_supported: My custom menu supports embedded Home Assistant cards
